title: What I Enjoy and What I Want
practice: Léela en voz alta 3 veces. Completa el espacio y luego dila en 1 minuto sin mirar.

rows.en: I **want to work** in {dreamCountry} one day.
I **decided to prepare** my CV in English.
rows.es: Decidí preparar mi CV en inglés.

rows.en: I **hope to get** interviews with companies there.
rows.es: Espero conseguir entrevistas con empresas de allá.

rows.en: I **practice speaking** English with this book.
rows.es: Practico hablar inglés con este libro.

rows.en: I **want my managers to see** my work on {project}.
rows.es: Quiero que mis gerentes vean mi trabajo en {project_es}.

rows.en: One day, I'd **like to start** my own business.
rows.es: Algún día, me gustaría empezar mi propio negocio.

dialog.text: What do you enjoy doing at work?
I enjoy solving problems, and I'm good at organizing data in {tool}.
Why did you decide to apply for this job?
I want to work on bigger projects and keep learning.
Would you mind moving to another city?
Not at all. I'm used to working far from home. I look forward to hearing from you.

pron.en: I'm looking forward to presenting it.
pron.pron: aim LÚ-king FÓR-wərd tə pri-ZÉN-ting it

check: Digo el monólogo en menos de 90 segundos, sin leer, y nunca digo enjoy to, want working ni looking forward to present.
